content: Spring Security 6 built-in OAuth2 Resource Server (spring-security-oauth2-resource-server + spring-security-oauth2-jose) natively validates and decodes JWT bearer tokens; a single property spring.security.oauth2.resourceserver.jwt.issuer-uri auto-configures the decoder via OIDC discovery when using an external IdP. For a self-issued-JWT scenario (no external IdP, auth-service mints its own tokens), the common pattern is NimbusJwtDecoder/JwtEncoder with an RSA or HMAC key. WebSecurityConfigurerAdapter is removed in Spring Security 6 -- use a SecurityFilterChain @Bean. @EnableMethodSecurity(prePostEnabled=true) replaces @EnableGlobalMethodSecurity.
